def snap():
    out=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']!='B':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return out
base=snap()
for (r,c,tag) in [(57,12,'orange-right'),(37,16,'cluster-dot'),(31,52,'cross-center')]:
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    ch=res['board_changed']
    print(tag,'-> changed',ch,'lvl',res.get('level_completed'))
    if ch:
        print('  diff vs base:')
        for x in snap():
            if x not in base: print('   +',x)
        for x in base:
            if x not in snap(): print('   -',x)
        break
</parameter>
